lines.text: *Swish*
Mihara swings her whip toward Gluttony.
*Thunk*
Sensing the threat, Gluttony attempts to retreat downward.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Heh, sorry to tell you this,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: but you're not going anywhere!
Mihara lunges forward, striking at Gluttony with the pendulum.
*Clang*
Gluttony twists its body and blocks the blade with its teeth.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Darn, it's good at sensing danger.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Maybe it knows instinctively that a hit from this is bad news.
*Swish*
Mihara steps back and swings the pendulum towards Gluttony once more.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Mihara! Watch out for the tentacles!
Gluttony extends its tentacles toward Mihara.
*Crunch*
Yuni grabs the tentacles.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo... coo!
*Crunch* *Crack*
Gluttony's tentacles writhe as if trying to escape Yuni's grip,
but she clenches the squirming bundle of feelers tightly and refuses to let go.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yuni!
*Groooowl*
With a thundering roar, a shower of splinters burst from Gluttony's body.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Everyone, duck!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Gaaaaah!
*Rat-tat-tat-tat-tat*
Mori fires her weapon
at the shards hurtling toward Mihara and Yuni.
*Bang bang bang*!
Some fragments that she wasn't able to shoot down fall to the ground.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Wow... your shooting has really improved, Mori.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I still missed a few, so don't get too comfortable.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, thankfully, it's too busy digesting something

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: to spew out that silver liquid.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: In that case... we've got a chance!
*Swish*
Mihara tightens her grip on her whip and charges forward.
Gyaaaah!
Mihara dodges the gaping maw attempting to swallow her,
*Crunch*!
and drives the pendulum into Gluttony.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Now then...
*Clank*
Dark purple chain-like patterns begin to etch themselves onto Gluttony's body,
accompanied by a cold metallic sound.
*Shrrrk*
At the same time, similar patterns appear on Mihara's body.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Now that our chains are connected,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: why don't we swap our senses?
The chain patterns engraved on Gluttony and Mihara's bodies glow a lambent purple,
*Clang*!
and the sound of chains tightening fills the air.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Ahh... I can feel it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: So this is what you're feeling?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, you really do have so much inside you.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Then, you've never felt...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: the sensation of your own cheek being bitten down on, have you?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, would you like me to show you?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Let's enjoy this pain together!
Mihara opens wide...
*Crunch*
and bites down on the inside of her mouth.
*Clang*
Gyaaaah!
Gluttony convulses as if in unbearable pain.
*Cruncch*
*Thudddd*
Gyaaaah!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, you're so spirited now!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Why don't we enjoy a little more?
*Crack*
Gyaaaah!
Gluttony trembles violently, its teeth clattering from the agony.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: My goodness, I didn't expect the pain to be so bad that you'd try to close your mouth.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: We can't have that, otherwise Mori won't be able to pass through.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Cooo!!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yuni?
Yuni lets go of the tentacles and quickly dashes forward.
She pries open the struggling Gluttony's mouth and forces her body inside.
*Crunnch*
While bearing the weight of its descending fangs,
she keeps its jaw forcibly open.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yuni!
*Crack... ck... ck...*
Gluttony continues to spasm in pain.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo... Coo ooh... Coo...!
Yuni uses every ounce of her strength to keep the creature's mouth open as the crushing weight of the razor-sharp teeth bears down on her.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: No, your body can't handle the stress!

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: ... Cooo!!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... You're incredible, Yuni.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo coo!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Yuni...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Mori!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You have exactly 30 minutes. Not a second more.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: After that, my sensory exchange will be severed.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You've got to convince Siren before then.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: 30 minutes?! That's all I have?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Can you do it?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... Yes. I can do this!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Then, go.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Go and rescue Siren!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo coo!
Mori looks at Yuni, who seems to be calling to her.
Yuni and Mori lock eyes.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: Coo coo!

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I can't believe it. Did she just wish you good luck?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... I think so.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Thank you, Yuni.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'll rescue Siren if it's the last thing I do!
Mori looks ahead toward the black chasm
that is Gluttony's gaping maw.
Meanwhile, Yuni desperately continues to keep the jaws open.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Ahhhh!!
Mori hurtles herself towards the creature's mouth,
and the black abyss slowly draws closer to her.
Suddenly...
*Rummmble*

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Huh?
Something falls at her feet.
A compass and a map that guide the way to the Ark.
A first aid kit to heal her wounds.
A chocolate bar to keep her hunger at bay.
A field shovel that has saved her skin more than once at critical moments.
Everything that has kept her alive until now falls to the ground,
and the reality she had been determined to avoid comes rushing at her head-on.
Along with it, the fear of death comes crashing in.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: No...
Somewhere deep inside her, a voice screams for her to stop.
A part of her wants to stop right there and cry out that she can't do this.
This is clearly insane,
like a suicide mission.
What if Siren is already dead?
What if she never realizes Mori is coming to save her?
What if there's still even the tiniest bit of silver liquid left in Gluttony's throat,
or if Yuni can't hold on any longer and the mouth closes?
What if Mihara collapses and can no longer restrain Gluttony?
She'll die.
She'll die in the most excruciating way.
The life she's fought so hard to hold onto will crumble away in an instant.
Just like how that shovel fell to the ground,
so will she go plummeting into death's cold embrace.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Nooo!
Even so, she has to run.
She must.
There are people out there who have risked their lives for her.
It's time for her to
repay the affection she's been given!
She's here to save the person
who reached out
and gave her a reason to live.
She has to go to her!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Gaaaaah!
Mori ignores the fallen remnants of her life, summons her strength,
*Tap*
and pushes off the ground with all her might.
She sends herself hurtling forward.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Siren!
Hurtling towards the lifeless abyss.
